# Discover Medspa

> Trusted directory of aesthetic injectors across every major Texas metro — Botox, dermal fillers, Sculptra, lip filler, and medspa services, ranked by real patient reviews.

Discover Medspa helps patients find verified, currently-operating aesthetic injectors in Texas. Listings are continuously refreshed and no provider pays for placement.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Search and browse trusted Texas aesthetic injectors.
- [Search](/search): Search injectors by clinic, name, or treatment.
- [Submit a business](/submit): Suggest a Texas injector for the directory.
- [About](/about): What Discover Medspa is and how listings are vetted.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the team for corrections, partnerships, or support.
- [Privacy](/privacy): How we handle your data and third-party sources.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of use and medical disclaimers.
